title: Carry local operator certificates through adaptive stopping with physical instruments
statement: If Q_(a,lambda)(F)=sum_y exp(lambda*r_(a,y)) M*_(a,y)(F)<=eta_a F for every allowed action and B0>=Tr(F rho0)/lambda_min(F), then Pr[exists t:lambda*S_t-sum_(j<t)log eta_(a_j)>=log B0+log(1/delta)]<=delta. Adaptive classical feedback and passive references are allowed; instruments include disturbance and holding noise. The controller need not measure F or reconstruct a conditional state. Calibration failure adds separately to operating failure.

requires: Actual physical outcome instruments, including disturbance and holding evolution, with declared rewards and positive tilted factors
A positive invertible F, eta_a>0 and actual operator inequalities Q_(a,lambda)(F)<=eta_a F for EVERY allowed action
Known B0>=Tr(F rho0)/lambda_min(F),0<delta<1; allowed classical adaptive action selection and stopping

Adaptive classical feedback and passive references are allowed; instruments include disturbance and holding noise. The controller need not measure F or reconstruct a conditional state. assumptions: This operator-to-anytime implication does not itself require locality, a mixing gap, stationary-state uniqueness or Choi calibration. Those are separate ways of acquiring its operator premise.
The visible final reports completed internal review, but separate proof/review/code originals remain unacquired; calibration and operating failure budgets add.
costs: Acquire or certify the actual operator inequalities and B0; all physical instrument/readout/holding work is paid
No measurement of F or conditional-state reconstruction is required by this implication; it does not provide a free operator-verification oracle
contract.units: Recorded reward in the declared instrument units, lambda in inverse reward, lambda*r and log(eta) dimensionless; time index counts instrument/source uses. Normalized Choi error and failure probabilities are dimensionless. Physical holding time, preparation and readout are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: Only normal visible HTML/text and deterministic original-TeX projection are acquired, not separately saved proof/review/code/raw-count originals. Reported internal acceptance and reported synthetic executions are retained honestly; no new execution or scientific audit here. Exact TP is essential to the centered O(lambda*xi) calibration debit. Supplied local support/addressability, memoryless instrument, holding noise and bounded neighborhood growth are substantive. Interval certification of floating eigensolves remains open. No optimized many-body/hardware/source advantage; ordinary tomography plus robust SDP contains the initial compiler and can use the new locality layer.
